about:
Harpak-ULMA Packaging, LLC is headquartered in Taunton, Massachusetts. The business traces its roots to 1994 when the Harlfinger family, drawing on over 30 years of packaging experience, established Harpak. On July 19, 2010, Harpak merged with ULMA Packaging—a company with more than 50 years of equipment and systems expertise—to form the current entity. The combined organization maintains a family-business atmosphere and emphasizes long-term customer relationships.

The company supplies end-to-end weighing, distribution, and packaging solutions, including vertical form-fill-seal (VFFS) machines, tray sealers, thermoformers, vision inspection systems, and metal detection/rejection equipment. It also provides installation, factory acceptance testing (including remote FAT), operator and maintenance training through its AICET-accredited academy, preventive maintenance programs, and a 24/7/365 parts and technical support network staffed by PMMI-certified technicians. Harpak-ULMA operates across North America with a field service presence and holds an NPS of 84 percent.

Primary markets include food processing (bakery, poultry, cheese, snack, and case-ready packaging), medical device packaging, and industrial packaging. The firm works with corporations in those sectors and, since 2024, supports Cabinplant weighing and packaging equipment owners in the U.S. and Canada through a full partnership.

Harpak-ULMA cites its six core values—integrity, commitment, service, excellence, teamwork, and innovation—as the foundation of its differentiation. The merger combined ULMA’s advanced design and manufacturing technologies with Harpak’s cultivated customer relationships, aiming to deliver a wider range of fully integrated packaging solutions while preserving a personal, family-business approach.
